title: Bounded Lipschitz cylinder multipliers and finite Q3 weighted products
question: Can the finite Q3 shifted form domain admit bounded finite-support C1 multipliers with bounded gradient, beyond the Weyl subclass, with explicit same- and cross-orientation weighted products?

model.bounded_multiplier: A_f is a finite-support multiplication cylinder with ||A_f||_infinity <= M and ||grad A_f||_infinity <= L
model.form_estimate: q_K[A_f psi] <= 2 M^2 q_K[psi] + L^2/chi ||psi||^2 for either shifted closed Q3 form
model.regularized_coordinate_test: a(x)=x/sqrt(1+x^2) has |a|<=1 and |a'|<=1; finite products over m coordinates have M<=1 and L^2<=m
model.weighted_bound: ||K_K^(1/2) A_f K_K^(-1/2)||^2 <= 2 M^2 + L^2/chi; cross-orientation products pay the factor 21

adversarial_review.check: The estimate assumes an explicit sup bound M and gradient bound L; no unbounded coordinate or polynomial is silently included.
The coefficient is 2M^2 for the form term and L^2/chi for the additive norm term, derived from the exact product-rule inequality.
The shifted onsite-plus-bond potential is nonnegative, so multiplication by |A_f|^2 is controlled by M^2 without a hidden negative remainder.
Cross products use the exact 21 form-order multiplier and are not conflated with same-form bounds.
Constants depend on support size and local M,L, not volume, within degree six; this is not a thermodynamic dynamics result.
All bounded local observables, unbounded polynomial products, modular transfer, common alpha, OS/KMS/GNS, gap, continuum, C6, Sector A and Pre-A remain open.

lean_crosscheck.boundary: Lean checks exact rational bounded-coordinate and multiplier arithmetic; it does not formalize the C1 product-rule theorem, operator representation, or QFT limits.

qft_interface.closed: A bounded finite-support Lipschitz cylinder algebra preserves the finite Q3 shifted form domains and has explicit same/cross-orientation weighted products uniform in bounded-degree volume.
qft_interface.open: All bounded local observables without explicit gradient control, unbounded polynomial products, modular/cutoff/beta transfer, direct D/delta-D Cauchy, common alpha, OS/KMS/GNS, gap, continuum and Pre-A.
qft_interface.tect_boundary: Bounded cylinder bridge only; no heat_root_incidence or canonical A1/R-192 production owner.

no_overclaim: This closes only the declared bounded finite-support C1 multiplier class and its regularized-coordinate test family. It is not an arbitrary-observable theorem, a modular dynamics result, a common alpha, OS/KMS/GNS reconstruction, a gap, continuum, C6, Sector A or Pre-A result.
